title: Laboratory Operations
subtitle: Luck Lab / Center for Mind & Brain
body: Laboratory Operations Manager (Junior Specialist) for one of the field’s defining ERP labs: participant pipelines, EEG rig upkeep, data-integrity standards, and training others to meet them. B.S., Quantitative Psychology & Neuroscience, UC Davis — Regents Scholar.
note: References: Dr. Steven J. Luck · Dr. John Kiat.
